svg.title: The LEO chain: signal, pass, navigation message, fused PVT and PPP
svg.desc: The LEO PNT chain from a real run of leo-pnt-chain (leo-pnt-end-to-end.toml): the signal stage (generic-l at 1191.795 MHz, pilot tracked at 10.23 Mchip/s) hands to the pass stage (1080 km, tracked C/N0 peak 58.2 dB-Hz), which hands to the navigation message (kepler-rac, 300 s fit, representation SISRE 0.91 mm RMS, 0.250 m with orbit determination), which feeds the fused fix (GNSS only 1.60 m RMS 3D, GNSS plus LEO 0.43 m) and precise point positioning (convergence 11.5 min GNSS only, 7.5 min with 240 LEO satellites). 11 values are handed between stages.
